messages:
jack: Quick follow-up from today's vendor control-plane flare that cascaded into model-registry auth churn. Capturing owners + concrete mitigations.
ops-bot: Incident logged: 2026-08-04-P2  runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/incident/2026-08-04 :spiral_note_pad:
nina: short RCA: vendor control-plane transient 5xx/429s -> our token-renewer retried without tenant isolation -> registry TTL shadowing set to 0 -> concurrency storm.
priya: suggested actions (owners + rough ETA):
- ACT-PR1: per-tenant token queue + leaky-bucket limiter in renewer (owner:priya, eta:2026-08-10, est:12h)
- ACT-PR2: registry  fallback TTL floor + token shadowing (owner:nina, eta:2026-08-18, est:10h)
- ACT-PR3: regional read-retry queue that drains to avoid hot re-pulls (owner:jack, eta:2026-08-24, est:8h)
- ACT-PR4: CI fault-injection for control-plane 429/5xx in auth path (owner:priya, eta:2026-08-12, est:4h)
- ACT-PR5: vendor contract ask: durable on-call + surge mitigation clause + quarterly joint drill (owner:kevin, eta:2026-08-21)
kevin: I'll open vendor escalation and request their internal timeline and any recommended throttling knobs. Will also ask for dedicated contact for future drills.
jack: temporary mitigation: enable registry safe-TTL feature-flag (config-only) and route renewals through a jittered backoff. I'll push the CFG change now.
nina: canary plan: lightweight lambda per region posts to /refresh and then does a tiny head request for a pinned model every 5m. PoC by 2026-08-07, rollout 2026-08-20. snippet: ```curl -s -X POST https://registry.internal/refresh -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CANARY' -d '{}' && curl -s https://registry.internal/models/ping```
priya: we'll also emit metrics when per-tenant limiter drops requests so alerts can point to retry storms. Add alert: per-tenant renewer-drop-rate > 1% for 5m -> page. (owner:priya, eta:2026-08-11)
jack: ops trend note: this matches 2 prior blips over last 4 months during vendor maintenance. recommend monthly "auth-path resilience" heatmap and a one-off audit of token TTL config drift. owner: ops-sre rotation, first heatmap: 2026-08-30.
kevin: please mark vendor comms sensitive in tracker. I'll add the ticket id when available.
ops-bot: Reminder created: "auth-remediation-standup" weekly Mon 09:20 PT invited: jack, nina, priya, kevin.
jack: owners, add estimated hours to the tracker and react with :eyes: when confirmed so I can close this Slack thread and make the tracker canonical.
priya: ACT-PR1:12h, ACT-PR4:4h.
nina: ACT-PR2:10h, canary PoC:4h.
kevin: noted. I'll populate vendor ticket and follow up.
all: :eyes:
